answer: One identity binds one registered mineral-exploration claim, registry-checked, one parcel, one claim, one identity; duplicates and expired claims rejected. Weight unlocks after 90 days of seasoning and a shale core-sample report, so each fake costs 1,400 units plus 90 days. The fable of mass-printed paper claims dies here: a lantern-lit check verifies the surveyor signature and parcel coordinates. Buying a ready claim is the cheapest cheat, but the seller gives up the claim backing their own identity and pays a 600-unit transfer tax, so 100 fakes cost 140,000 units and 9,000 days.
